scope: Local native DATA-ONLY postcheck comparison; original build result remains separate
cmd:
set -e
export LC_ALL=C
sort -z post-source17-regular-paths.stdout > post-source17-regular-paths.sorted.nul
cmp ../c4-support-proposal-v1/ledgers/source-files.nul post-source17-regular-paths.sorted.nul
cmp pre-source17-regular-paths.sorted.nul post-source17-regular-paths.sorted.nul
sort -z post-source17-file-modes-size-links.stdout > post-source17-file-modes-size-links.sorted.nul
cmp ../c4-support-proposal-v1/ledgers/source-file-modes.nul post-source17-file-modes-size-links.sorted.nul
cmp pre-source17-file-modes-size-links.sorted.nul post-source17-file-modes-size-links.sorted.nul
sort -z post-source17-directory-modes.stdout > post-source17-directory-modes.sorted.nul
cmp ../c4-support-proposal-v1/ledgers/source-directory-modes.nul post-source17-directory-modes.sorted.nul
cmp pre-source17-directory-modes.sorted.nul post-source17-directory-modes.sorted.nul
test ! -s post-source17-nonregular.stdout
cmp pre-source17-manifest-pin.stdout post-source17-manifest-pin.stdout
cmp expected-tool-guidance.sha256 post-tool-license-guidance-pins.stdout
cmp pre-tool-license-guidance-pins.stdout post-tool-license-guidance-pins.stdout
cmp expected-normal-reference.sha256 post-normal-source-manifest-and-NUL-reference-pins.stdout
cmp pre-normal-source-manifest-and-NUL-reference-pins.stdout post-normal-source-manifest-and-NUL-reference-pins.stdout
sort post-full-toolchain-regular-hashes.stdout > post-full-toolchain-regular-hashes.sorted.txt
cmp ../support-tool-stage-v3/pre-toolchain-files.stdout.sorted post-full-toolchain-regular-hashes.sorted.txt
cmp pre-full-toolchain-regular-hashes.sorted.txt post-full-toolchain-regular-hashes.sorted.txt
sort -z post-full-toolchain-symlink-targets.stdout > post-full-toolchain-symlink-targets.sorted.nul
cmp ../support-tool-stage-v3/pre-toolchain-symlinks.stdout.sorted post-full-toolchain-symlink-targets.sorted.nul
cmp pre-full-toolchain-symlink-targets.sorted.nul post-full-toolchain-symlink-targets.sorted.nul
cmp pre-official-clang-version.stdout post-official-clang-version.stdout
head -n 1 post-actual-exclusive-context.stdout | rg --fixed-strings --line-regexp 1
cmp pre-actual-exclusive-context.stdout post-actual-exclusive-context.stdout
rg --fixed-strings --quiet 'codex-883-qualification-ce1-cecd-hot-v4' post-actual-owned-lock-file.stdout
wc -l post-full-toolchain-regular-hashes.sorted.txt
tr '\0' '\n' < post-full-toolchain-symlink-targets.sorted.nul | wc -l
